Switch to Build when you are happy. safetydiffs SPLTEK · LLM AI HARNESS AI CODING AGENT A full AI coding agent for VS Code and VSCodium that lives in your Activity Bar. It reads your project, edits files, runs commands, searches the web and keeps one persistent conversation per folder — with tool calling and live streaming. Bring your own model. Cloud, or a local LLM on your laptop through Ollama, LM Studio or llama.cpp. One protocol: the OpenAI Chat Completions API. src/llm/http.ts, then run the suite. { "path": "src/llm/http.ts", "offset": 42, "limit": 9 } async request(url: string, init: RequestInit) { for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) { const res = await fetch(url, init); if (res.ok || !isRetryable(res.status)) return res; await sleep(Math.min(2000, 250 * 2 ** attempt)); } Test Files 133 passed (133) Tests 2988 passed (2988) Duration 20.39s DEMO / ONE SESSION “Harny creates its own website” — the session that produced this page, recorded end to end. 00 / WHAT HARNY IS Harny is an AI coding agent for VS Code and VSCodium. It runs as an extension: a chat panel in the Activity Bar with a real agent loop behind it. It reads your project, writes and edits files, runs shell commands, greps, globs, reads diagnostics, searches the web and keeps one persistent conversation per folder. Tool calls and the model's answer stream into the transcript as they happen, so a run is something you watch rather than something you wait for. It is a local LLM coding agent as much as a cloud one. The model is a row in a settings dialog, not a subscription: point Harny at Ollama, LM Studio or a llama.cpp server on localhost and nothing leaves the machine — no key, no account, no per-token bill.
